;-----------------------------------------------------------
;SCREEN TOOLS SOURCE
;ORIGINALLY (C)Lynx/xplosive team
;-----------------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
               LD      IX,windsc
stwin          CALL    setwin
rep            CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JR      rep
ldos           RET

vbf1           LD      HL,#c000
               JR      vbf
vbf2           LD      HL,#db00
               JR      vbf
vbf            PUSH    HL
               CALL    sssr
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               POP     HL
               LD      DE,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               CALL    rpkey
               CALL    ankey
               CALL    ussr
               CALL    rpkey
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
film           CALL    getfil
               CALL    rpkey
               LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               CALL    gtadr
               LD      DE,11
               ADD     HL,DE
               LD      A,(HL)
               INC     HL
               OR      A
               RET     NZ
               LD      A,(HL)
               CP      #1b
               RET     NZ
               CALL    gtadr
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               CALL    dos
               LD      C,14
               LD      A,#ff
               LD      HL,#c000
               CALL    dos
               RET
slebf          PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,sbfwin
               CALL    setwin
               CALL    rep
               POP     IX
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    frfsh
               LD      H,#ff
               RET
sssd           PUSH    HL
               CALL    remw
               LD      IX,windsc
               CALL    frfsh
               POP     HL
               RET
sbf1           LD      HL,#c000
               POP     DE,DE,DE,DE,DE,DE,DE
               CALL    sssd
               RET
sbf2           LD      HL,#db00
               POP     DE,DE,DE,DE,DE,DE,DE
               CALL    sssd
               RET
inv            CALL    slebf
               LD      A,H
               CP      #ff
               RET     Z
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      BC,#1800
inv_1          LD      A,(HL)
               CPL
               LD      (HL),A
               DEC     BC
               INC     HL
               LD      A,B
               OR      C
               JR      NZ,inv_1
               RET

optimiz
               CALL    slebf
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    sssr
               POP     HL
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      A,H
               CP      #ff
               RET     Z
               PUSH    HL
               LD      DE,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               CALL    opty
               POP     DE
               LD      HL,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               CALL    ussr
               RET


opty           LD      HL,#5800
               LD      BC,#300
utrom          LD      E,(HL)
               LD      A,E
               AND     7
               LD      D,A;INK
               LD      A,E
               AND     #38
               SRA     A
               SRA     A
               SRA     A;PAPER
               CP      D
               JR      Z,equal
               JR      NC,more
next           INC     HL
               DEC     BC
               LD      A,B
               OR      C
               JR      NZ,utrom
               RET
equal          AND     7
               CP      1
               JR      NC,eqfil

               SLA     A
               SLA     A
               SLA     A
               OR      A
               JR      NZ,eq_1
               LD      A,7
eq_1           LD      (HL),A
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    attosc
               CALL    xordsym
               POP     HL
               JR      next
eqfil          AND     7
               LD      (HL),A
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    attosc
               CALL    whsymb
               POP     HL
               JR      next

more           LD      E,A
               LD      A,D
               SLA     A
               SLA     A
               SLA     A
               OR      E
               LD      (HL),A
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    attosc
               CALL    invsym
               POP     HL
               JR      next
xordsym        XOR     A
               !ASSM   8
               LD      (HL),A
               INC     H
               !CONT
               RET
whsymb         LD      A,#ff
               !ASSM   8
               LD      (HL),A
               INC     H
               !CONT
               RET



invsym
               !ASSM   8
               LD      A,(HL)
               CPL
               LD      (HL),A
               INC     H
               !CONT
               RET

attosc         LD      A,H
               ADD     A,A
               ADD     A,A
               ADD     A,A
               AND     #7f
               LD      H,A
               RET
unpck
               CALL    slebf
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    sssr
               POP     HL
               LD      A,H
               CP      #ff
               RET     Z
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      (makemoreshit+1),HL
               PUSH    HL,IX,IY
makemoreshit
               CALL    0
               POP     IY,IX,DE
               LD      HL,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               CALL    ussr
               RET
upd1           LD      DE,#100
               LD      HL,(lents)
               ADD     HL,DE
               LD      (lents),HL
               CALL    rfsh
               RET
upd2           LD      DE,#100
               LD      HL,(lents)
               AND     A
               SBC     HL,DE
               LD      (lents),HL
               CALL    rfsh
               RET


windsc         DB      5,5,6,6
               DW      nmedsc,vbf1,vbf2
               DB      17,1,1
               DW      opy1
               DB      7,17,2,1
               DW      opy2
               DB      7,17,3,1
               DW      opy3
               DB      7,17,4,1
               DW      opy31
               DB      7,17,5,1
               DW      opy32
               DB      7,17,6,1
               DW      opy4
               DB      7,#FF
sbfwin         DB      7,8,7,2
               DW      nmesel,vbf1,vbf2
               DB      17,1,1
               DW      opy5
               DB      7,17,2,1
               DW      opy6
               DB      7,#FF
hlpwin         DB      1,1,19,17
               DW      hlpnm,ldos,ldos
               DB      16,1,1
               DW      heltxt
               DB      0,#FF
svwin          DB      4,5,8,4
               DW      svnm,vbf1,vbf2
               DB      19,1,3
               DW      fnamer
               DB      9,17,2,1
               DW      opy7
               DB      9,17,3,1
               DW      opy8
               DB      9,17,4,1
               DW      opy9
               DB      9,#FF
slwin          DB      8,10,7,3
               DW      slnm,vbf1,vbf2
               DB      20,2,3
               DW      lents
               DB      6,10,2,7
               DW      upd2
               DB      0,11,2,8
               DW      upd1
               DB      0,#FF


sethlp         PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,hlpwin
               CALL    stwin
               POP     IX
               CALL    frfsh
               RET
savwin         PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,svwin
               CALL    stwin
               POP     IX
               CALL    frfsh
               RET
selwin         PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,slwin
               CALL    stwin
               POP     IX
               CALL    frfsh
               RET
sv1bf          LD      HL,#c000
               JR      sv
sv2bf          LD      HL,#db00
sv             LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               PUSH    HL
               CALL    olen
               LD      HL,fnamer
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,8
               LDIR
               POP     HL
               LD      A,"C"
               LD      (#5ce5),A
               LD      C,11
               LD      DE,(lents)
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
olen           LD      HL,fnamer
               LD      B,8
nn             LD      A,(HL)
               OR      A
               JR      Z,nn2
               INC     HL
               DJNZ    nn
               RET
nn2            LD      A,#20
mm3            LD      (HL),A
               DJNZ    mm3
               RET



hlpnm          DB      " Information...",0
nmedsc         DB      "SCTools",0
nmesel         DB      "Select...",0
opy1           DW      film
               DB      " - File Menu -",0
opy2           DW      optimiz
               DB      " - Optimize -",0
opy3           DW      inv
               DB      "  - Invert -",0
opy31          DW      unpck
               DB      "  - Unpack - ",0
opy32          DW      savwin
               DB      "   - Save -",0
opy4           DW      sethlp
               DB      "   - Info -",0
opy5           DW      sbf1
               DB      " - Buffer 1 -",0
opy6           DW      sbf2
               DB      " - Buffer 2 -",0
opy7           DW      sv1bf
               DB      " - Save Buffer 1 -",0
opy8           DW      sv2bf
               DB      " - Save Buffer 2 -",0
svnm           DB      "Save...",0
opy9           DW      selwin
               DB      " - Select length -",0
slnm           DB      "New length",0
lents          DW      6912
fnamer         DB      "filename  ",0,0,0,0,0,0,0

heltxt         LCODE   "sctHE.tx";HELP TEXT
               DB      0,0,0
